newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to hover around 135.55 resistance.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to hover around 135.55 resistance.

text.p: September BTP futures on LIFFE are likely to range trade on Friday and make little progress beyond Thursday's close, but a strong downside lure remains, analysts said.
The market will close near to Thursday's settlement price of 135.55, analysts said.
"There's a lot of potential to the downside, but we're still in an uptrend, so I see us coming in at 135.50/55," said Oliver Boettger, technical analyst at DMG Futures and Options in Frankfurt.
BTPs were at 135.50 at 0702 GMT, down five basis points.
BTPs briefly broke above the 135.55 level to set a new contract high of 135.60 in early trade, before pulling back to hover around the 135.55 level.
"The market still looks very bullish even if the RSI is very high," Boettger said. "The market can still rally."
The relative strength index (RSI) was showing a reading of 74.325 in early trade. RSI over 70 percent indicates a contract is in overbought territory.
On the downside, Boettger pegged support at 134.66, but said that any move below that level would put an end to the uptrend and trigger a big correction.
Hans-Guenter Redeker, European technical strategist at Chase, placed initial support at 135.20, but said any break below would trigger a decline to the 134.84/70 level.
Support at 135.20 coincides with near-term up trendline support, Redeker said in a research note.
At the short end, September Eurolire were quoted at 93.50, down 0.01 on the day.
A technical analyst at a European bank pegged Eurolira resistance at 93.55/57. The analyst said in a research note he remained bullish and saw a quickening in pace once resistance was broken.
